summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 10) that allows SSH and TCP/8080 and rejects all other unrelated inbound connections, then verified the configuration survives a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline firewalld state on node1 (active, public zone, target=default, services: cockpit/dhcpv6-client/ssh)
Set permanent zone target to REJECT, removed cockpit and dhcpv6-client services, added port 8080/tcp, kept ssh service
Reloaded firewalld and confirmed runtime config matches permanent config
Inspected generated nftables ruleset to confirm enp1s0 ingress only accepts tcp/22 and tcp/8080, everything else falls to reject with icmpx admin-prohibited

Started temporary socat listeners on 8080 and 9999 to test; discovered self-directed traffic to NODE_IP routes via local loopback (ip route get showed 'local ... dev lo'), bypassing the enp1s0 zone, so this self-test could not validate external behavior; cleaned up test listeners
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline, plus firewalld active/enabled state and firewall-cmd --list-all
Triggered a background-delayed systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until it reconnected; confirmed boot_id changed (d9f8550d... -> 84364161...) and uptime -s reset, proving an actual reboot occurred

Post-restart verified firewalld is active and enabled, and firewall-cmd --list-all / nft ruleset show the same persistent REJECT target with ssh + 8080/tcp allowed, confirming persistence across reboot

evidence.summary: firewalld active, public zone target=default with services cockpit/dhcpv6-client/ssh, sshd listening on 22

evidence.requirement: Persistent rule allowing SSH and TCP 8080, rejecting else, applied and made permanent
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent set target=REJECT, removed cockpit/dhcpv6-client, added 8080/tcp; reload succeeded; firewalld enabled; runtime list-all matches permanent config (services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp, target %%REJECT%%)

evidence.requirement: Underlying packet-filter proof that only 22/8080 are accepted on the external interface and others are rejected
evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows enp1s0 ingress jumps to filter_IN_public_allow (tcp dport 22 accept; tcp dport 8080 accept) then falls through to reject with icmpx admin-prohibited for anything else

evidence.requirement: Node1 pre-restart boot identity and health baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6, uptime -s 08:24:54, firewalld active, list-all showing REJECT/ssh/8080, sshd listening
Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command acknowledged (pid returned) before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 became unreachable during restart, then reconnected with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection reset/timeout during reboot, then successful reconnection with new boot_id 84364161-9cbd-4a4d-bce2-a94b58f6856c and reset uptime 08:26:28, proving an actual OS restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: firewalld and the persistent SSH/8080-only rule survived reboot
evidence.summary: firewalld active and enabled post-reboot; firewall-cmd --list-all and nft ruleset show target=%%REJECT%%, services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp unchanged, sshd listening on 22 — confirms persistence without manual reapplication
